title: Jump Game
contract: Nonnegative entries give maximum forward jump length. Decide whether the final position is reachable; input is nonempty.
optimal: long farthest=0;for(int i=0;i<a.length;i++){if(i>farthest)return false;farthest=Math.max(farthest,(long)i+a[i]);emit("Extend the reachable prefix","index",i,"farthest",farthest);if(farthest>=a.length-1)return true;}return true;
reasoning: Try every legal next jump recursively; many paths revisit the same position.
If every index up to farthest is reachable, scanning any index in that prefix can only extend reachability.
An index beyond farthest exposes an uncrossable gap. This greedy proof relies on being able to choose any jump up to the maximum, not exactly the stated jump.
